description: Compact ring transact data of each rail at statement version 4 and what the ring program forwards for it, the SPP TransactIxData, the SPP instruction data and the external data hash over the SPP tag, the data before private_tx_hash and two settlement accounts per leg. Byte 0 carries the policy, curator, no_spend, in-proof owner, own root, second tree, reply metadata and extension flags. Byte 1 indexes SPP_SUPPORTED_SHAPES below the default owner tag (bit 6) and public owners (bit 7). Byte 2 is the input count below has_data (bit 6) and entry (bit 7), byte 3 is m, byte 4 the approval mask below the co-signer count. The ring proof and the tracking revision follow, the own revision under the own root flag, the curator revision under the curator flag, the expiry as a u32, the viewing key, the salt and the extensions under their flag. The interface transfers follow, the SPL withdrawal owners under the own root flag, exit_bits and bodiless_bits of ceil(m / 8) bytes each. A slot is a u16 body length under has_data, its hash, its tag and its body, 72 bytes for a recipient body and 83 for an exit without has_data. Under reply metadata a u16 reply_len and reply_len bytes per body-bearing slot follow the slots. The anonymous frame's scheme 12 bundle follows as a 32-byte tag and 80 + 32 m bytes, then eph_u, the envelope, m records of 112 bytes and under has_data m tails of 64 bytes, the lengths those of ring-disclosure-ranges-v4.json. The auditor message is 0x04 || eph_u || envelope || records || tails. Recipient bodies forward as scheme 13, u16le(body_len) || body || reply. Produced by program-libs/interface/tests/transact.rs.
